name: Villalba de Perejil (Spain)
description: Red field with white and yellow chevrons pointing downward from the upper corners, charged with three blue stars.
history: Municipal flag of Villalba de Perejil; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron pointing downward from the upper corners
three stars, one within the chevron and two at the sides
